humans.bio: I am a detail-oriented AI Annotation and Data Entry Specialist with over 6years of experience dedicated to delivering high-quality datasets for machine learning and analytics. I have a proven track record of producing over 500,000 labeled records with exceptional accuracy, consistently maintaining 98-99% quality. My expertise includes labeling and validating large volumes of data, such as the 300,000+ records I managed at Surge AI. I am adept at standardizing unstructured data, identifying duplicates and inconsistencies, and processing significant record volumes, up to 15,000 monthly. I am committed to quality, having reduced rework by 25% and actively conducting peer quality checks. I thrive in remote environments and consistently meet tight deadlines.

humans.headline: Photographer & Videographer | Graphic Designer | English-Spanish Translator
humans.bio: I'm a freelance photographer and videographer with experience dating back to 2015 and a background in graphic design. I help clients turn their ideas into compelling visual stories, from planning creative shoots and setting up lighting to editing and delivering polished images. I work with Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, and Illustrator, and my editing skills include color correction, skin retouching, and special effects. I enjoy collaborating with clients to understand their vision and offer creative guidance, and I'm equally comfortable working independently. I hold a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have completed additional training in photography and digital art. I also work as an English-Spanish translator and interpreter and have experience teaching and tutoring Spanish.

humans.name: Jercyl Joy Raba
humans.headline: AI Voice Data Evaluator | English & Tagalog | Graphic & Logo Designer
humans.bio: I evaluate AI voice conversations in English and Tagalog, checking responses for accuracy, relevance, clarity, naturalness, and conversational flow. I provide objective ratings, annotations, and structured feedback based on project guidelines, identifying misunderstood speech and incorrect responses. My background also includes graphic design, logo creation, printing services, and customer support. I use Canva and Adobe Photoshop to create visual materials, prepare print-ready artwork, and revise designs based on client feedback. I bring attention to detail, analytical thinking, and experience translating customer requirements into clear designs and accurate order details.
